_comment_wake_words: 唤醒词，中英文都可以写多个。用户叫其中任何一个，都视为唤醒这个伴侣。留空则不启用。
_comment_wake_words_en: Wake words, one or more, Chinese and English both fine. Any of them wakes this companion. Leave empty to disable.
_comment_tool_prefix: MCP 工具名前缀（默认 agent）。改成伴侣名字的拼音/英文，例如 xiaohui，工具就变成 xiaohui_wake / xiaohui_note_today。
_comment_tool_prefix_en: MCP tool-name prefix (default "agent"). Set it to your companion name in lowercase, e.g. "xiaohui", to get xiaohui_wake / xiaohui_note_today.
_comment_linux: On Linux: change python_env to Bridge/.venv/bin/python3
_comment_dream: Nightly consolidation is OFF by default — set dream_enabled=true to enable it (one light API call per night; empty nights cost nothing). It runs only on dream_host (hostname, suffix-stripped, case-insensitive) and reads LIVINGOS_LLM_API_KEY / LIVINGOS_LLM_BASE_URL / LIVINGOS_LLM_MODELS from the environment — see docs/DreamAndSync.md.
